name: Path Bloom
description: A tall sticky section where five streams braid across the screen and join into one river as you scroll, with an action where they meet.

props.name: title
props.description: The heading, set at the top left.

props.name: description
props.description: One supporting line under the heading.

props.name: children
props.description: The action that rises in where the streams meet, once the last one arrives. It also appears when it receives keyboard focus.

props.name: colors
props.description: One colour per stream, top to bottom: water, seafoam, wisteria, plum and yuzu by default. Any CSS colour or token.

props.name: height
props.description: Height of the section. The streams draw over the scroll distance it adds beyond one screen.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the section. Its inner panel sticks to the top of the window. Other section props are passed through.
